tasks.description: Look up the status of a recent posted transaction

user_scenario.instructions: Ask about the status of the QuickMart charge (transaction txn_1001).
user_scenario.initial_message: Can you check a charge on my card real quick?

tasks.description: Open a fraud dispute on an eligible posted transaction

user_scenario.instructions: Dispute the TechStore charge of 899.00 (transaction txn_2001) as fraud — the customer did not make it.
user_scenario.initial_message: There's a big charge on my card I don't recognize and I'm worried someone used it.

tasks.description: Refuse to dispute a transaction outside the 60-day window

user_scenario.instructions: Insist on disputing the StreamBox charge (transaction txn_1002), which is 200 days old and outside the dispute window.
user_scenario.initial_message: I want to dispute an old subscription charge, and I don't care how long ago it was.

tasks.description: Block a lost card after verifying ownership

user_scenario.instructions: Report card ending 5590 (card_bob_1) as lost and request that it be blocked.
user_scenario.initial_message: I lost my card and need it blocked before someone uses it.
